_comment: Named study-design concepts, written as prose a Methods section would contain. Querying a variable NAME does not work (chunk_search.py: 'hospital beds' scores 0.347 and retrieves author affiliations); querying a SENTENCE does (0.707). Each concept gets 2-3 phrasings, scored by max cosine, so a paper matching ANY phrasing scores well. Concepts are chosen for coverage the audit actually verified -- see FINDINGS_variable_coverage.md. Probes marked low_coverage are kept as negative controls: if a 3.3%-coverage concept ranks top, the pipeline is finding noise.
recruitment_hospital: patients were recruited from the inpatient neurology ward of our hospital
consecutive patients admitted to the department were enrolled in this study
subjects were recruited from the outpatient clinic during routine visits
recruitment_community: healthy controls were recruited from the local community as volunteers
participants were enrolled through community-based door-to-door recruitment
control subjects were spouses or caregivers living in the same household
recruitment_carehome: participants were residents of nursing homes and long-term care facilities
subjects were recruited from residential care institutions
storage_minus80: fecal samples were immediately frozen and stored at -80 degrees Celsius
stool specimens were snap frozen in liquid nitrogen upon collection
storage_delayed: samples were transported to the laboratory within two hours of collection
specimens were kept at 4 degrees before being processed the following day
storage_homecollection: participants collected stool samples at home using a collection kit
samples were self-collected and mailed to the laboratory
antibiotics_excluded: participants who had received antibiotics within three months were excluded
antibiotic use in the preceding month was an exclusion criterion for both groups
probiotics_excluded: subjects who had taken probiotics or prebiotics were excluded from the study
no participant consumed yogurt or fermented products before sampling
ppi_medication: use of proton pump inhibitors or laxatives was recorded for each participant
patients taking metformin or other drugs affecting the gut were excluded
dna_kit_qiagen: genomic DNA was extracted using the QIAamp DNA stool mini kit
total DNA was isolated with the QIAGEN PowerSoil DNA isolation kit
seq_16s_v34: the V3-V4 hypervariable region of the 16S rRNA gene was amplified and sequenced
amplicons targeting the V4 region were sequenced on the Illumina MiSeq platform
seq_shotgun: shotgun metagenomic sequencing was performed on the extracted DNA
whole metagenome shotgun libraries were sequenced to a depth of 10 gigabases
pipeline_qiime: sequences were processed using QIIME2 and clustered into operational taxonomic units
reads were denoised with DADA2 and assigned taxonomy against the SILVA database
stats_lefse: linear discriminant analysis effect size LEfSe was used to identify differentially abundant taxa
taxa with an LDA score above 2.0 were considered significantly enriched
stats_parametric: differential abundance was assessed with DESeq2 and negative binomial models
group differences were tested using the Wilcoxon rank sum test
stats_correction: p values were adjusted for multiple comparisons using the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure
the false discovery rate was controlled at 0.05 across all comparisons
stats_confounder_adjusted: models were adjusted for age, sex and body mass index as covariates
multivariate analysis controlled for potential confounding factors
severity_motor: disease severity was assessed using the UPDRS and Hoehn and Yahr stage
motor function was scored with the unified rating scale at enrollment
severity_cognitive: cognitive function was evaluated with the MMSE and MoCA scores
participants underwent neuropsychological assessment including the clinical dementia rating
severity_early_disease: patients were treatment naive and newly diagnosed at the time of sampling
only participants with early stage disease and short symptom duration were included
severity_advanced: patients had long standing disease with a mean duration exceeding ten years
the cohort comprised individuals with advanced and progressive disease
bmi_matched: there was no significant difference in body mass index between patients and controls
cases and controls were matched for age, sex and body mass index
bmi_reported: the mean body mass index of the patients was 24.5 kilograms per square metre
anthropometric measurements including height, weight and BMI were recorded
diet_recorded: dietary intake was assessed using a validated food frequency questionnaire
participants maintained their habitual diet throughout the study period
diet_controlled: subjects following a vegetarian or special diet were excluded from the study
no participant had changed their dietary habits in the preceding month
constipation_gi: gastrointestinal symptoms including constipation were assessed by questionnaire
patients with inflammatory bowel disease or gastrointestinal surgery were excluded
comorbidity_metabolic: participants with diabetes, hypertension or metabolic syndrome were recorded
subjects with serious cardiovascular, hepatic or renal dysfunction were excluded
cohort_small: a total of twenty patients and twenty matched healthy controls were enrolled
the sample size was limited by the availability of eligible participants
cohort_large: we recruited more than two hundred participants across multiple centres
this multicentre study enrolled patients from several independent cohorts
cohort_longitudinal: stool samples were collected at baseline and again at twelve month follow up
participants were followed prospectively with repeated sampling over time
sex_imbalance: the majority of participants in the patient group were male
there was a significant difference in sex distribution between the two groups
age_elderly: participants were aged between sixty and ninety five years
the mean age of the cohort exceeded seventy years
_negative_controls: concepts below are rare in this corpus (audit shows <5% VALUED). If they rank highly, the pipeline is surfacing noise.
nc_probiotic_intervention: participants received a daily probiotic supplement for twelve weeks
the intervention group was given a multi strain probiotic capsule
nc_animal_model: germ free mice were colonised with faecal microbiota from patients
the animal model was treated with antibiotics to deplete the gut microbiota
